content: Just a couple of weeks before Meta Connect starts on September 23rd, UploadVR posted images seemingly revealing the design for Meta’s “Project Phoenix” headset. The images, which UploadVR says were “found in the HorizonOS Prescription Lens firmware package,” suggest Meta may be looking to compete with devices like those from Xreal or Viture. These companies’ mixed reality glasses are a bit bulkier than something like Meta’s Ray-Ban AI smart glasses, but a step down from a full VR headset like Meta’s Quest 3.  This leak shows something that’s almost in between larger headsets and smart glasses, with lenses set into a slim, glasses-style frame. A shot from behind shows a wire extending from one of the earpieces, possibly for a battery or compute puck. There also appear to be outward- and downward-facing cameras in the earpieces.  Project Phoenix has been in the works for a while now, and isn’t expected to launch until next year. Google is also working on a pair of Project Aura XR glasses in a similar vein, with an external compute puck that’s wired to the frames.

chineseContent: 就在 9 月 23 日 Meta Connect 启动前几周，UploadVR 发布了一些图片，似乎揭示了 Meta 的“Project Phoenix”耳机的设计。 UploadVR 称这些图像“在 Horizo​​nOS Prescription Lens 固件包中找到”，表明 Meta 可能正在寻求与 Xreal 或 Viture 等设备竞争。这些公司的混合现实眼镜比 Meta 的 Ray-Ban AI 智能眼镜要大一些，但比 Meta 的 Quest 3 等完整的 VR 耳机要小一些。这次泄漏显示的东西几乎介于较大的耳机和智能眼镜之间，镜片设置在纤细的眼镜式框架中。从后面拍摄的照片显示，一根电线从其中一个耳机延伸出来，可能是用于电池或计算盘。听筒中似乎还有朝外和朝下的摄像头。  凤凰计划已经酝酿了一段时间，预计要到明年才会启动。谷歌还在以类似的方式开发一副 Project Aura XR 眼镜，该眼镜带有一个连接到镜框的外部计算圆盘。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
